name: Scale
description: Resizes the picture with bilinear sampling, with FFmpeg scale's width and height rules.

params.name: w
params.description: Output width; 0 = the input's, -n = from the height keeping the aspect ratio, a multiple of n

params.name: h
params.description: Output height; 0 = the input's, -n = from the width keeping the aspect ratio, a multiple of n
